title: GokuMohandas/Made-With-ML: a production ML learning path
friendlyTitle: Made-With-ML teaches how to build and run real ML systems
summary: Made-With-ML is a practical, open repository covering how to develop, deploy, test and iterate on production-grade machine-learning applications. It has about 49,600 stars and includes notebooks, datasets, deployment examples and tests.
friendlySummary: This popular open course goes beyond training a model. It also covers testing, deployment, data quality and improving a system after launch.
whyItMatters: The project gives practitioners a structured path from modelling into data quality, testing, serving and operational iteration. Teams can also use its examples as a checklist for the engineering work that a notebook-only prototype leaves out.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it as a learning path or as a checklist for an ML project. It helps show what is needed to turn a notebook into a dependable service.
